description: Redesign lib/inventory_screen.dart into the visual nevera/caducidades mechanism: group items by location (Nevera / Congelador / Despensa) with a per-section header showing an icon and counts, order items within each section by soonest expiry first, and show a per-item status chip Fresco / Caduca pronto / Caducado with cozy color + icon using the status colors added in FEAT-002. Keep ALL existing functionality: add, delete, comida/hogar type filter, is_staple toggle and 'Siempre en casa' badge, the CategoryIcons.badge emoji leading, the empty-state Miau, and the 'fab-inventory' FloatingActionButton heroTag. Replace hardcoded colors with AppColors / AppTheme.cardDecoration.
steps: Depends on FEAT-002 (uses InventoryItem.expiryStatus / daysUntilExpiry / effectiveExpiry and the new AppColors status pairs). In lib/inventory_screen.dart, keep the existing data flow (_fetchItems, _reload, _deleteItem, _toggleStaple, _openAddItem, _typeFilter and the type filter SegmentedButton, the FutureBuilder, the empty-state with MiauCharacter).

After applying the comida/hogar filter, group the resulting list by location. For food items use category ('Nevera','Congelador','Despensa'); hogar items (Limpieza/Hogar) should still appear when the filter includes them, grouped under a sensible non-food section header (e.g. 'Hogar y limpieza') since they have no expiry. Define a fixed section order: Nevera, Congelador, Despensa, then Hogar/limpieza. Within each food section, sort items by daysUntilExpiry ascending with items that have no expiry (sinFecha) placed last; keep a stable order for the hogar section.

Build the list as sections: render a section header for each non-empty location showing an icon (e.g. Icons.kitchen for Nevera, Icons.ac_unit for Congelador, Icons.shelves/Icons.inventory_2 for Despensa) and a count line like 'Nevera · 4' and, for food sections, a small summary of how many caducan pronto / caducados if any. Use AppColors and AppTheme.cardDecoration; no hardcoded hex colors.

For each food item card, show a status chip (pill) using the FEAT-002 status colors and an icon: Fresco (green, e.g. Icons.check_circle), Caduca pronto (amber, e.g. Icons.schedule), Caducado (red, e.g. Icons.warning_amber_rounded). The chip text should be day-aware and Spanish: 'Caducado', 'Caduca hoy', 'Caduca mañana', 'Caduca en N días', or a plain date for far-off fresco items. Items with no expiry show a neutral 'Sin fecha' chip or no chip. Keep the quantity/category/kind/servings subtitle line.

Preserve the trailing actions: the push_pin is_staple toggle (only for comida) and the delete button. Preserve the 'Siempre en casa' and 'hogar' badges in the title row. Keep the FloatingActionButton heroTag 'fab-inventory'. Replace the screen background and all hardcoded Color(0xFF...) usages with AppColors equivalents (cream, wood, woodDark, ink) and AppTheme.cardDecoration() for card containers.
Keep behavior identical when embedded (widget.embedded) vs standalone (AppBar shown). Ensure setState uses block bodies.
If any reusable small widget helps (e.g. an ExpiryChip), it may live in lib/widgets/ but is optional; prefer private helpers in the screen to keep scope tight.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory screen groups items under Nevera / Congelador / Despensa section headers (and a Hogar/limpieza section for non-food when shown), in that fixed order, each header showing a count.
Within food sections, items are ordered by soonest expiry first, with no-expiry items last.
Each food item shows a Fresco / Caduca pronto / Caducado status chip with the cozy green/amber/red colors from AppColors and an icon, with Spanish day-aware text.
Add, delete, comida/hogar filter, is_staple toggle, 'Siempre en casa' and hogar badges, CategoryIcons.badge leading, and empty-state Miau all still work.
FloatingActionButton heroTag is still 'fab-inventory'. No raw hardcoded hex colors remain in inventory_screen.dart (uses AppColors / AppTheme).
flutter analyze 0 issues, dart format clean, flutter test green.
